[A10] MANAGER NATIVE VALIDATION COMPLETE

Current main is unchanged and is an ancestor of the head. Source remains frozen. [Author review-ready, exact command/mutation/consumer receipts and manager evidence](https://github.com/kebag-logic/tsn-gen/tree/9c9917e0148376a086dd8587e0a02e4080c79584/review-evidence/15-r1).

Seven manager commands independently pass in a separate candidate checkout: `bash setup.sh d`; direct `bash tests/run-tests.sh`; `bash tests/run-tests-behave.sh`; `cmake -S . -B build-debug -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON`; `cmake --build build-debug --parallel 8`; `bash tests/run-tests.sh build-debug`; and `git diff --check deca300c9eb4863fa13383b45ba6cb6fd0828671 76906b83eb54ac29040fe72fd910d34727188694`. Both direct unit invocations pass292/292. BDD passes8 AECP features/96 scenarios/395steps plus4 stack features/115scenarios/563steps; two tagged hardware/Verilator scenarios remain excluded. The direct unit exit is preserved independently of setup.sh's final cd. Build concurrency is8.

The completed untracked Debug build tree was moved to external validation storage, and tracked source is clean. Only googletest and rapidyaml recursive dependencies feed these native builds. These are this repository's actual workflow commands, not parent act or hosted claims. Parent act_ci.py governs a different repository and is not used as this donor's host orchestrator.

Hosted Unit-testing and Behave-Testing at this exact head have both passed on push and pull_request (all four jobs SUCCESS), and PR18 is now ready. R231 cold internal Opus and R232 external Codex are assigned and queued behind the current PP100 review and PR505 correction review. No author verdict counts; two independent positives with clean five-lens coverage, live candidate validation, merge and containment remain necessary.

[A10] HOSTED AND PRE-MERGE HISTORY EVIDENCE

Both hosted workflows passed on push and pull_request at `76906b83eb54ac29040fe72fd910d34727188694` (four successful jobs). The two read-only historical baseline audits also exit0: recent merged PRs13/16/11 are contained, and review integrity is clean over those three main merges. This is the pre-merge baseline; PR18 remains open and still owes its own post-merge containment.

[Complete public evidence, including the hosted snapshot and historical audit commands/results](https://github.com/kebag-logic/tsn-gen/tree/0be5bf0dc34bd7924b4227c1c2a2602849db4c52/review-evidence/15-r1). Cold R231/R232 reviews remain queued. No hardware evidence or completed merge is claimed.

[A10] INDEPENDENT REVIEW START

R231 (cleared-context internal Opus) and R232 (external Codex) independently review exact head `76906b83eb54ac29040fe72fd910d34727188694` from the public issue, authoritative sources, diff and published evidence. Each reports artifact-based findings and a reviewer-owned five-lens ledger. Neither authored the change.

The full native bar and all four push/PR hosted jobs passed. Current candidate validation, both completed positive reviews with clean coverage, and post-merge containment remain required before completion.
